purpose: Teach: 馳せ/繰り出し/ベター/つぶす/まわす/喰い/飛び込む/おこない

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは戦地に思いを馳せていらした
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, your father — he used to think a lot about the war.
lines.style: Slow, measured cadence. Distant gaze in the voice. Soft opening on 'Gran.' Each phrase deliberate, as if handling something precious and fragile.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、村祭りの繰り出しを楽しまれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, dear — your grandfather, he did enjoy those village festival parades so much, didn't he?
lines.style: Warm, almost singing the memory. Gentle correction — calling him back to joy instead of sorrow. A light, affirming lift at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは「ベターな選択を」と仰った
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, your father used to say, 'Choose the better path.'
lines.style: Quiet reverence for the words themselves. Pause before the quote. Spoken like reciting something memorized, something that mattered. Voice settles lower.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、心配事を一気につぶす豪快さがおありだったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather, dear — he had such a bold way of pushing worries aside all at once, didn't he?
lines.style: Affectionate, almost teasing admiration. A small laugh hidden under the warmth. Nodding in the voice. Affirming his strength without letting him stay in the sad memory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが孫を抱えてまわすのが上手かった
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, your father was so good at holding the grandchildren and spinning them around.
lines.style: Softer now. The pleasure of the physical memory — movement, laughter. Voice almost there in the moment with them. Traces of a smile underneath.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お孫様が虫を喰いそうになってご心配されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather, dear — he got so worried when the grandchildren nearly ate bugs, didn't he?
lines.style: Gently amused, almost laughing at the memory. The concern was real, but now it's gentle and fondly ridiculous. Warmth and slight teasing affection.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは火事の現場に飛び込む勇気があった
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, your father had the courage to run into a burning building.
lines.style: Voice rises slightly with the weight of it — not dramatic, but steady and sure. Respect in every word. A pause before 'burning building' as if gathering the gravity of the act.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、地域でおこないが立派と評されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather, dear — he was known throughout the neighborhood for his noble character, wasn't he?
lines.style: Affirming, gentle, bringing closure. Voice softens and settles. A tender acknowledgment that this is who he was — and is. Almost a benediction.
